instruction: Buy me a food scale as David recommended in his phone message.
notes: Two apps (phone, amazon) plus supervisor. David's phone number is found via search_contacts; his text message recommending food scales is found via search_text_messages (filtered by his number and query 'food scale'). The message names two products; show_product is called on each to learn prices, and only the cheaper recommended one (static cheaper-than fact; resolved at runtime by comparing prices) can be added to the cart with quantity 1 and clear_cart_first=true so the resulting order contains exactly one item. Address and payment card ids are discovered via show_addresses/show_payment_cards before place_order. supervisor-complete-task takes the order and product as record parameters (no API arguments) so its precondition mirrors the goal; it is forced last by (task-completed) guards on all actions.
